text: Born in St Albans. Obsessed with hip hop.
He never planned to make drum and bass.
slides.sub: He bought his first sampler with a £2,000 Prince's Trust loan.

text: No one knew it was the same person.
slides.sub: He was building a technique in the dark.

text: People heard it and didn't understand

quote: He named his tracks after samurai.
I'd make that out of something else
slides.note: He ran noises through delays. Re-sampled them. Rebuilt percussion from shadow.

text: The samurai had reached the peak.
So he put the sword down.
slides.sub: 2000. He left drum and bass. Moved to Los Angeles. Retreated to the underground.

text: The greatest DnB album of the '90s
was made by a man who refused
to stay in drum and bass.
